environment.cloud: Disposable real Control and Artifact Workers, WorkspaceHub, D1 and R2
environment.browser: Headless Chromium; compiled production ArtifactViewer and separate hostile iframe/top-level suite

regressions.same_clock_baseline: Two staged consumers fulfilled before the guard fix; one must reject.
regressions.body_bound_baseline: Both declared and streamed bodies over 4096 but below 8192 bytes returned 403 instead of 413.
regressions.same_clock_current: Eight simultaneous real-D1 redemptions at one fixture timestamp return exactly one 200 and seven 403, with one redemption audit.
regressions.body_bound_current: Declared and streamed oversized bodies return 413 without R2 reads or grant consumption.
regressions.view_audit_current: Real two-isolate Hub dispatch creates one metadata-only projection per issued/redeemed source under concurrency, lost reply and transient cache loss.

browser_boundaries.active_preview: No grant or frame before Run preview; Stop removes the frame; Reload obtains a different grant.
browser_boundaries.passive_preview: Compiled viewer renders actual published Markdown through the isolated artifact origin.
browser_boundaries.authentication_loss: Reload fails visibly and removes the frame without issuing another grant.
browser_boundaries.csrf: Missing CSRF rejects browser grant creation before an effect.
browser_boundaries.revocation: A queued grant fails unconsumed after epoch rotation; revoked membership also denies fresh compiled-viewer issuance.

not_claimed: Production or persistent pilot feature enablement
Live-provider launch, agent-to-agent work or remote-start acceptance
Core-board visual redesign, private-task ACLs, project knowledge, catalogs or business secrets
Full Mermaid language or compressed log decompression
End-to-end Worker static-asset routing: the compiled fixture bundle uses a synthetic HTTP transport; authenticated API, Hub, D1 and R2 behavior uses real Workers
redaction: Bounded synthetic assertions and counts only; no credentials, private content, machine paths or raw output retained. Historical manifest and captures are unchanged.
